issues.detail: The Hebrew has no explicit subject 'cỏ' (grass) or 'người ta cắt' (people cut); the verbs are impersonal/third-person masculine singular referring to the grass/flower from the previous verse, and 'yimolel' means 'it withers/fades' (intransitive), not 'people cut it'. The addition of 'người ta cắt' introduces an agent not in the Hebrew and changes the action from withering to being cut.
